periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Verified all 41 food sites in the resource directory by phone and added Saturday hours at a North Inlet pantry. Ran the first food worry survey to set a baseline. Partners: Harbor Area Food Bank, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add pantry sites through faith partners in Harbor Creek and Old Ferry Road and scout a Seagrove mobile stop.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Added faith partner pantries in Harbor Creek and Old Ferry Road and a produce shelf at a Housing Authority building, bringing listed sites to 44. Chose a site for the Seagrove mobile stop. Partners: Harbor Area Food Bank, Harborview Housing Authority, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Open the Seagrove mobile stop, a Bayshore pantry and a Riverside produce table.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Brought the directory to 49 free and low-cost food sites by adding a Bayshore pantry, a Seagrove mobile stop and a Riverside produce table. Surveys now show 14.6% of adults worried about running out of food, down from 15.8% in Q1. Partners: Harbor Area Food Bank, Harborview Housing Authority, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Map walking distance to sites and place one new distribution in Dune Avenue, the longest gap, before the holidays.
